run_mcts_tic_tac_toe: run Monte Carlo Tree Search against a random agent on tic_tac_toe
run_mcts_human_game: run MCTS agent against a human player on tic_tac_toe
run_mcts_solve: run MCTS-Solver on tic_tac_toe with 1000 simulations and exploration constant 2
run_mcts_multi_game: run multiple MCTS vs random games on tic_tac_toe with seed and verbose stats
run_mcts_gtp_bot: run MCTS agent against an external GTP bot on tic_tac_toe with custom commands
